phases.title: Own centered contact
phases.purpose: Create a stable strike window at controlled tempo.

phases.title: Shape trajectory
phases.purpose: Add launch windows without losing contact quality.

phases.title: Choose targets
phases.purpose: Transfer the pattern into representative decisions.

assessment.title: Starting assessment
assessment.summary: Strike drifts toward the heel when transition tempo increases.

evidenceItems.title: R6 contextual note
evidenceItems.interpretation: Wind and target variability were intentionally absent from this lesson task.
evidenceItems.limitation: This note supplies context but does not itself demonstrate a change.

evidenceItems.title: R6 current comparison
evidenceItems.interpretation: Current carry is shown beside the baseline without implying causation.
evidenceItems.limitation: Conditions were synthetic and the two small sets cannot prove durable change.

evidenceItems.title: R6 centered-strike count
evidenceItems.interpretation: Four centered strikes were counted in the six-shot task.
evidenceItems.limitation: The task was controlled and did not include course decisions.

evidenceItems.title: R6 strike measurement
evidenceItems.interpretation: Median carry was recorded without converting the source unit.
evidenceItems.limitation: Six synthetic shots are too few to infer stable performance.

evidenceItems.title: R6 golfer report
evidenceItems.sourceLabel: Golfer reflection recorded after the lesson
evidenceItems.interpretation: The golfer reported that the comfortable tempo felt easier to repeat.
evidenceItems.limitation: Self-report was not independently measured on course.

evidenceItems.title: R6 coach observation
evidenceItems.sourceLabel: Coach observation during bounded indoor set
evidenceItems.interpretation: Contact improved when transition tempo stayed comfortable.
evidenceItems.limitation: One indoor set cannot establish on-course transfer.
